source_caption_text:
Nine Vicious addressed Ken Carson and ApolloRed1’s “9 B*tches” diss during an Instagram Live yesterday (Sept. 19), brushing off the track while pointing out that they made an entire song about him.

“Think about the mental state you gotta be in to make a song about another ni**a... They went in that studio and rapped about Nine Vicious”

Ken Carson later fired back in a now-deleted post, writing, “Knew you was gone stand down,” before adding, “Just don’t speak on my gang lil bra” and “Everybody a killer til its time to kill.”
